messages.text:
Hi Luis,

I'm putting together the programme for Smallprint 2025, a one-day conference in Bristol on Thursday 13 March at the Paintworks. About 220 people, mostly in-house designers from charities, councils and small agencies.

Someone on our committee saw your prototype of the Brightwell Trust volunteer form and wouldn't stop talking about it. Would you do a 25-minute talk on designing for charities with very little budget? We pay £300 plus travel and a night in Bristol if you want it.

It would help to know by 6 December, but even a maybe is useful.

Amara

Amara Quist
Programme Lead, Smallprint
smallprintconf.example

Hi Amara,

Yes in principle. I'll check with Priya on Monday and let you know.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Hi Luis,

I'm so sorry, this is embarrassing. About an hour after your reply our main sponsor pulled out, and the board met this morning and decided not to run Smallprint in 2025 at all. So there's no talk to clear with Priya.

We're aiming to come back in 2026 and I'd like to ask you again then, if you'll still talk to me.

Amara

Amara Quist
Programme Lead, Smallprint
smallprintconf.example

keyDates.what: Smallprint 2025, now cancelled
Original deadline for Luis's answer

facts: Smallprint 2025 was planned for Thursday 13 March 2025 at the Paintworks, Bristol, for about 220 people.
The fee offered was £300 plus travel and a night in Bristol.
The talk would have been 25 minutes on designing for charities with little budget, based on the Brightwell Trust sign-up work.
The conference was cancelled because its main sponsor pulled out; the board decided on Saturday 23 November 2024.
truth.summary: Amara Quist invited Luis to give a 25-minute talk at Smallprint 2025 in Bristol; he said yes in principle, then the conference was cancelled for 2025 when its main sponsor pulled out.

messages.text:
Lift's out AGAIN since yesterday teatime. Notice on the door says engineer "this week", photo attached so you can all enjoy it. I've rung Corrigan, ref CBM-20417. Has anyone else rung? The more of us the better.

Bernie (Flat 5)

I rang too, they gave me the same ref. I'm first floor so it's not killing me, but I've got two parcels for Flat 4 that are too heavy for the stairs. Is anyone in Flat 4 home tonight?

Aga

Update: engineer came this afternoon, it's a part, on order, "about two weeks". Two more weeks of doing those stairs with the shopping and this knee. I could cry.

Bernie (Flat 5)

Bernie, that's grim. If you want a hand with a big shop at the weekend, knock on Flat 3.

Harriet (cc'd), anything that makes stairs easier on a dodgy knee?

Luis (Flat 3)

Hi Bernie,

Good leg first on the way up, sore leg first on the way down. One step at a time, both feet on each step. Use the rail and leave the heavy bags to Flat 3.

If it's still sore after the lift's back, ring the clinic and ask for me.

Harriet

Harriet Lowe MCSP
Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

messages.subject: Lisbon tips? (was: Lift out AGAIN)
messages.text:
Thank you both, I've stuck Harriet's list on the fridge. "Good leg up" is going on my gravestone.

Completely different thing while I've got you all: we're going to Lisbon for our 30th at the start of July and we've never been. Any tips?

Bernie (Flat 5)

Happy 30th! My friend Rita (cc'd) lives there and has never steered me wrong. Rita, the lovely woman from the top floor needs help.

L

Hi Bernie,

How lovely, and congratulations. Stay up the hill rather than down by the river; it is quieter at night. If you do one thing, go to the viewpoint at Santa Catarina an hour before sunset, the one with the big stone giant, and get a drink from the kiosk. I usually take something from the bakery in case the kiosk is shut.

And take shoes with grip. The pavements are polished stone and they are lethal.

Love, Rita

messages.subject: Lift out AGAIN
messages.text:
Rita you're a star, the giant is on the list.

Back to the lift. It's been a week. Has anyone heard anything from Corrigan about the part? I've rung twice and got a voicemail both times.

Bernie (Flat 5)

Harriet

Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

L

Glasses yes, phew. Tin no.

Harriet

Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

Then the tin is a mystery. Niamh thinks it's Desmond's from downstairs, he brought mince pies in it in July, which is a sentence I can't explain.

I can drop your glasses at the clinic on Thursday morning on my way to work?

Thursday's no good, I'm on a course all day and the clinic's shut till 2. Could you bring them to the Saturday drop-in instead? 10 till 12. Or I'll come to you one evening, whichever is less faff.

Harriet

Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

messages.text:
Hi Kerry,

A favour, if you can. My friend Joanna Kowalczyk (cc'd) cracked a back tooth on a piece of nougat last night and her own dentist in Leyton can't see her until 3 November. She's in a fair bit of pain.

Do you have any emergency slots this week? She's happy to go private. Dr Kemal was very patient with me over the crown.

Thanks,
Luis Cordero

Dear Mr Cordero, Dear Ms Kowalczyk,

Thank you for your email. We can offer a private emergency appointment on Tuesday 13 October at 12:20 with Dr Kemal. The emergency fee is £65, with any treatment charged separately.

Ms Kowalczyk, as a new patient, please arrive ten minutes early to complete a medical history form, and bring a list of any medicines you take.

Kind regards,

Kerry Simmonds
Reception, Whitlock Cut Dental
8 Wilton Way, London E8 1BG | 020 7946 0745
Please give 48 hours' notice of cancellations or a £35 fee applies.

Hiya Luis,

After the brittle incident I suppose I had it coming. I've asked Asha to swap lunches. Kerry, yes please to 12:20. I'll bring my list.

Jo x

Dear Ms Kowalczyk,

I'm sorry to let you know that Dr Kemal is unwell today, so we have had to move your appointment. We can see you on Wednesday 14 October at 16:10 with Dr Haines instead. The fee is unchanged. Please reply to confirm, or call us on 020 7946 0745 if this time doesn't suit.

Kind regards,

Kerry Simmonds
Reception, Whitlock Cut Dental
8 Wilton Way, London E8 1BG | 020 7946 0745
Please give 48 hours' notice of cancellations or a £35 fee applies.

keyDates.what: Jo's first emergency appointment, 12:20, cancelled
New appointment offered to Jo, 16:10 with Dr Haines
Earliest slot at Jo's own dentist in Leyton

facts: Jo cracked a back tooth on nougat.
The private emergency fee is £65, with treatment charged separately.
New patients arrive ten minutes early for a medical history form and bring a list of medicines.
Jo asked Asha to swap lunch so she could make 12:20.
Whitlock Cut's phone number is 020 7946 0745.
truth.summary: Luis asked his dentist's reception to fit in his friend Jo, who cracked a tooth; Kerry booked her for Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 12:20, then moved it to Wednesday 14 October at 16:10 with Dr Haines because Dr Kemal was ill, and asked Jo to confirm.
